questions.question: 'Nor westers' are thunderstorms which are prominent in ________.
questions.solution:
Nor westers or the Kalbaishakhi is a local thunderstorm and rainfall which occurs in India and Bangladesh.

Kalbaishakhi occurs from March till monsoon establishes over North-East India. Odisha, West Bengal, Assam, Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Bangladesh, and North-Eastern states of India are affected by violent thunderstorms during this period.

Kal Baisakhi originates in the Chhotanagpur Plateau, in and around the cities of Ranchi and Jamshedpur. In times of incursion of moist air in these elevated regions, amidst high temperatures, these extremely destructive thunderstorms occur.

Kal Baisakhi definitely brings destruction in terms of lightning, thunderstorm, hailstorm, and rainfall. However, it is extremely helpful for pre-Kharif crops like jute, paddy, and a large number of vegetables and fruits. It gives the much-desired relief after mid-day heat and pours well on the thirsty soil for the development of crops.

questions.question: What is the SI unit of temperature?
questions.solution:
**__Explanation__:**

**Celsius scale:**

__
 
• In this scale, a **lower fixed point (ice point)** is taken **0°** and the **upper fixed point** **(steam point)** is taken **100°**.
 
• The **temperature measured** on **this scale** all in **degree celsius (°C)**.

**Fahrenheit scale:**

 
• This scale of temperature has a **lower fixed point** at **32° F** and an **upper fixed point** at **212° F**.
 
• The **change in temperature of 1° F** corresponds to a **change of less than 1° on the Celsius scale**.

**Kelvin scale:**

 
• The **Kelvin temperature scale** is also known as the **thermodynamic scale**. The **triple point of water** is also selected to be the **zero of the scale of temperature**.
 
• The temperatures measured on this scale are **in Kelvin (K)**.
 
• The **S.I unit** of **temperature** is **Kelvin**.

**Note:__**

 
• The **Kelvin** is the **primary unit of temperature** but is often used in **conjunction with the Celsius degree**, which has the same magnitude. Therefore option 1 is correct.
 
• The definition implies that **absolute zero (0 K)** is equivalent to **−273.15 °C**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c35f77405f2cdff3137f5b58b81f46dbe2ceae13baf74dacb1ddf00458f063a.png] 

All these temperatures are related to each other by the following relationship:

frac{{F - 32}}{9} = (C)/(5) = frac{{K - 273}}{5}

questions.question: At which of the following place, the weight of an object is maximum?
questions.solution:
**__CONCEPT__:**

**Weight:**

__
 
• The **weight of an object** is defined as the **force of gravity on the object** and may be calculated as the **mass times the acceleration of gravity**, i.e.,

W = mg

Where m = mass of the object and g = acceleration due to gravity

 
• Since the **weight is a force**, so its **SI unit** is the **Newton**.

EXPLANATION__:

 
• Acceleration due to gravity at the surface of the earth is given by:

Rightarrow g = frac{{GM}}{{{R²}}}

 
• As Earth is elliptical in shape i.e., it is flattened at the poles and bulged out at the equator, due to which the equatorial radius is about 21 km longer than the polar radius.
 
• As the polar radius is smaller than the equatorial radius, therefore the acceleration due to gravity is maximum at poles and minimum at the equator. 
 
• As we know the **weight of an object** is equal to the **mass times the acceleration of gravity **i.e., **w = mg**.

Mass of the body always remains constant.

questions.question: How much water (in litres) must be added to 80 litres solution of milk and water containing 10% milk, so that it becomes a 5% milk solution?

 10%

 5 - 0 = 5

 Ratio = 5 : 5 = 1 : 1

The foreman said to his workers "I cannot pay you higher wages."

options.text: The foreman warned his workers that he cannot pay them higher wages.
The foreman told his workers that he could not pay them higher wages.
The foreman told his workers that they could not be paid higher wages.
The foreman forbid his workers to pay higher wages.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**The foreman told his workers that he could not pay them higher wages.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Direct Speech. As per the given question we have to change it into Indirect Speech. 
 
• The Process of Transformation as follows:
 
 
• 'Said' will be changed into **'told'**. Because the reporting verb has an object after 'said'.
 
• Comma and inverted comma will be added.
 
• The conjunction 'that' will be added.
 
• 'I' will be changed into 'he'.
 
• 'you' will be changed into **'them'**
 
• ''Can't'' will be changed into ''couldn't''.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

 

Correct Answer:__* The foreman told his workers that he could not pay them higher wages.*

**The question below consists of a set of labelled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph.**

P: It has been the handmaid of the ruling class.

Q: Therefore, ever since the dawn of civilization, persons in power have always tried to supervise or control education.

R: Education is an instrument that imparts knowledge and therefore, indirectly controls power.

S: It is an old saying that knowledge is power.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**SRQP**__ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is an example of a Sentence Jumble. 
 
• The first statement of a sentence jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, or the starting of an incident
 
• Part S will be the first sentence because it is clear that that the flow of topics is from knowledge to power to education. Therefore, Sentence S comes first introducing knowledge and power.
 
• Part R will be the next sentence because it mentions the agent that imparts 'knowledge'
 
• Part Q will be the next sentence because it starts with 'therefore'. You use therefore to introduce a logical result or conclusion. Here it is concluding why people in power during the ancient era try to supervise or control education.
 
• Lastly, Part P will be used because it concludes all the sentences.

**The correct sequence is:__** *It is an old saying that knowledge is power. Education is an instrument that imparts knowledge and therefore, indirectly controls power. Therefore, ever since the dawn of civilization, persons in power have always tried to supervise or control education. It has been the handmaid of the ruling class.*
